objective: Correct Community Wall photo collage duplication and full-screen photo paging while preserving each distinct original photo and its order.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Android Production OTA run #249 published update 01a1a62f-f53e-7569-a4ef-306df0e0082b on production channel, Android runtime 1.3.2, from source SHA 4ed0d427b54c9ced99dfc0615b19f8cfac8dabab. Current main includes later non-OTA source changes; this branch is DEV-only until its own exact-head gates and a new RC/OTA.
chosenApproach: Deduplicate collage items by normalized original Storage object identity across media_path, signed media_url (ignoring expiring query tokens), and external object keys. Use preview sidecar identity only when no original identity exists, so a stale/shared preview can never hide distinct originals. Keep the public Wall vertical full-screen photo FlatList mounted for one viewer session and remount only when a new collage is opened.
selectionRationale: The supplied screenshots show duplicate-looking collage tiles and a two-photo full-screen sequence. The shared collage component and public Wall viewer are the common source of truth; correct identity normalization and viewer lifecycle without changing image quality, signed URL authorization, zoom, reactions, or save behavior.
preserveBehaviors: Distinct original photos retain their original media order and remain available in the full-screen viewer
Duplicate media references with rotated signed URL tokens do not render twice
A stale or shared preview sidecar cannot hide two distinct original photos
Vertical full-screen photo paging remains stable and does not remount on each index change
Private photo signing, Android preview/original upgrade, zoom, reaction and Save actions remain unchanged
No database, RLS, storage policy, package identity or native dependency changes
acceptanceChecks: The same Storage object referenced by a path and a signed URL is rendered only once
Distinct originals remain distinct even when their preview_path values collide
Photo order remains stable from collage tile selection through the full-screen viewer
The photo viewer FlatList key changes for a new viewer session but not for each swipe
Focused regression tests cover duplicate identity, distinct originals, ordering and vertical viewer paging
alternativeApproaches: Deduplicate solely by preview_path (rejected: a stale preview mapping could hide a distinct original photo)
Deduplicate by the complete signed URL (rejected: query tokens rotate for the same Storage object)
Keep viewerIndex in the FlatList key (rejected: every swipe remounts and resets the vertical pager)
